newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end slightly up as Dow punctures gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end slightly up as Dow punctures gains.

text.p: UK shares made little headway on Wednesday, closing slightly firmer as a faltering Dow dragged the FTSE 100 index of leading shares back down to earth after an earlier rally.
Dealers and analysts said trade was very sector-specific with foreign-earning companies suffering over continuing concerns about the impact of a strong sterling on profits.
The FTSE closed 8.7 points higher at 4,087.5 after retreating from a high of 4,098.4 as the Dow reversed early gains. Gainers outweighed decliners by a six-to-four majority.
"The volatility of Wall Street has been a factor once again," said Corey Miller, strategist at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
